_doc: THE WORKING VERSION of the piano solo (SW-96; RUNNING_LOG §307 — his word: 'can we get like a working version that we work in and that keeps all our changes'). The workshop's page 'working version' = the page `base` (the standard figures taken one by one, notation/hand/<base>.units.json) with the GESTURES below drawn over it, and nothing else. A gesture hides the played notes inside its span. kind ribbon = Shape Action Notation's arc: t0 its start, bounce its impact (the 'hit'), t1 its end; flow.profile = its designed width (§296). kind strike = the scattered strike: a curtain from t0 to t1 with the thrown pebbles. A chord symbol (each hand's pitch set, bank/chord_changes.json `sets`) stands at the start of every ribbon and strike. His times are 'thereabouts' — he clicks them with the mouse. A POLE (a fixed structure in standard notation) is not here: it is a figure in the units file.

shapeRule._note: §310: a chord symbol of four pitches or more with no gap over a MINOR THIRD is a cluster bar (the prototype's rule was a whole step; a hand's set read over the whole solo has small holes, and a nine-note chord with six accidentals is not a symbol one reads)
